blocks.text: Contribute namespaced vehicle definitions with contributeVehicle. World creation receives a space-sim-vehicles/1 catalog built from enabled authoritative contributions. The trainer inherits the selected system vehicleDefaults; fixed-handling craft can coexist. contextFor(ship) selects the craft handling for simulation, prediction and observations. Exact packages are required for version 4 saves and vehicle-aware sessions; legacy craft map to spacelab.trainer/orbit-trainer without altering their state.
